operations.before: Let $K_J:=\bigoplus_{u\in W_J}RT_u$. If $u\in W_J$ and $j\in J$, the left and right length-multiplication rules in [F3] express $T_jT_u$ and $T_uT_j$ as linear combinations of $T_{ju},T_u$ and $T_{uj},T_u$ respectively; since $ju,uj\in W_J$, both products lie in $K_J$. Each $T_u$ is a product of the generators indexed by $J$, so $K_J$ contains the subalgebra they generate; conversely it is closed under multiplication by every such generator and contains $1$, so every word in those generators lies in $K_J$. Hence $K_J$ is exactly that generated subalgebra.
